dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (Japan Medical Association open-source clinic system), compiled with GnuCOBOL; uses 'coblog' call and '.so' shared-library file access pattern typical of ORCA/GnuCOBOL
evidence: STRING WRK-PRTPG DELIMITED BY SPACE ".so" DELIMITED BY SIZE

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (claims) software - retrieves online receipt form name and output destination printer name for inpatient/outpatient processing
purpose.summary: This subprogram (ORCSPRTNM) retrieves the online receipt form program name and output printer name for the JMA ORCA medical billing system. Given a classification code and inpatient/outpatient flag, it looks up the appropriate print program name from system management tables or falls back to defaults. It supports both API and interactive modes.

notable_features: LINKAGE SECTION with USING clause (called subprogram)
Multiple COPY statements (12) for JMA ORCA copybooks
STRING with DELIMITED BY SIZE/SPACE for .so filename construction
SPA (Scratch Pad Area) pattern typical of ORCA online programs
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
verdict.notes: Source comments are in Japanese encoded as EUC-JP but decoded as latin-1, causing mojibake in the displayed text. The program is part of the well-known JMA ORCA open-source medical receipt system. Source is truncated at 16000 chars but enough structure is visible for confident classification. Revision history shows versions from 2003 through 2009.
